news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹926.9m (US$9.96m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Sancode Technologies Limited Announces Appointment of Ramraj Singh Thakur as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective from February 26, 2026
news.body: Sancode Technologies Limited at its meeting held on February 26, 2026, has considered and approved, inter alia, the appointment of Mr. Ramraj Singh Thakur (Membership No. A51179), as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with immediate effect i.e., February 26, 2026. Mr. Ramraj Singh Thakur is a qualified associate member from Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He has experience of more than 5 years.

news.title: Sancode Technologies Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 100.000026 million in funding from Trinity Gate Limited, Aneka LLC
news.body: Sancode Technologies Limited announced private placement to issue up to 2,325,582 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 43 for gross proceeds of INR 100,000,026 on February 26, 2026. The transaction includes participation from Khushboo Jain for 465,000 warrants, Aneka LLC , for 370,195 warrants, Trinity Gate LLC for 1,490,387 warrants. Each Warrant can be converted into 1 Equity Share of the Company and conversion can be exercised at an exercise price of INR 129 at any time within a period of 18 months from the date of allotment of Warrants, in one or more tranches as the case may be and on such other terms and conditions as applicable. news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 6 experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Sumesh Mishra was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.1% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
